notes: 306 library compounds plus positive reference RMC-0741051-001 are represented across two biological replicate folders, 20260902 and 20260904. The folders contain instrument measurements dated September 2 and September 3, respectively.

Per user-confirmed layout, each A/B plate pair contains the same compounds and concentrations. A is without CypA inhibitor; B adds 25 µM CypA inhibitor. A compound IDs and doses are transferred from the matching-number B map based on this confirmation.

Curves are calculated from raw acceptor/donor ratio and plate-specific DMSO/no-HaloTag controls. The supplied corrected B export was used to verify replicate 1. The 143 source-reported increasing classifications and parameter fits are preserved in a separate report because it does not identify plate or biological replicate assignment.

DMSO controls are in column 22 and no-HaloTag controls in column 23, per the experiment setup. Biological replicates remain separate; technical duplicate wells are summarized as means and SDs at each dose.

Selected biological replicate 2, condition B. Raw ratio source measurements, controls and fits belong to this run only. No reported GDS fit is assigned to this run because the source parameter export lacks replicate identifiers.
